newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude mixed in light U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude mixed in light U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil was mixed in U.S. paper trading on a quiet Thursday afternoon, as many traders headed off early for the U.S. Independence Day holiday on Friday.
Four partial August Brent cargoes traded 100 times apiece, two at $18.17 and one each at $18.15 and $18.20.
August Brent closed at $18.17 a barrel on London's IPE.
August/September Brent changed hands at minus 11 cents a barrel, two cents weaker than an earlier transaction in London.
September/October Brent was pegged around minus 12 at minus nine cents.
